summary: Stocks rebounded Friday, with tech names recovering from Thursday's AI-driven selloff. The Dow gained nearly 400 points as oil prices eased on cooling Mideast supply fears.
market_note: Indexes poised for weekly gains; big-bank earnings kick off next week.

items.why: Retook its 50-day moving average as investors positioned ahead of Q3 earnings, with analysts calling the valuation attractive on AWS strength.
Bernstein reiterated Outperform with a $641 target, pushing back on AI capex fears, while SaaS names saw broad dip buying.
Record Cybercab registrations in Texas and a Tigress Buy reiteration with a $550 target kept momentum going.
Fear gauge fell as stocks rose, tech rebounded, and easing oil prices reflected calmer Mideast supply fears.
